game_title: Sum Sprint – Fairy Ring Glade Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Fairy Ring Glade, a glade ringed by mushrooms: the herbalist must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Sum Sprint: Accumulate a total across a loop to pay a toll at Fairy Ring Glade.
theme: Mystic Forest – Fairy Ring Glade: a glade ringed by mushrooms
core_gameplay_loop: In Fairy Ring Glade, repeat each round: Accumulate a total across a loop to pay a toll at Fairy Ring Glade. Each round, a new spirit lanterns challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the total value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 270 points of spirit lanterns by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 270, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Sum Sprint
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Sum Sprint' (Week 5 slot 5), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Fairy Ring Glade'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how total changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bog toads in Fairy Ring Glade.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 270 within 71 seconds.
